correctness.rationale: The proof fixes the exact product order, an explicit deletion order, and a greatest strict predecessor for every deleted off-level point. originality.rationale: The closest inspected finite-space sources establish the minimal sphere model and study its topological complexity, but do not give a deleted-product reduction or identify the two-point configuration core. Focused semantic-index and web searches for the claim, deleted-product aliases, configuration-space wording, beat-point reductions, and the anti-diagonal formulation found no covering statement. A prior result on finite crowns covers only one-dimensional crown spaces and only a weak-equivalence projection; the present claim is restricted to \(n\ge2\) and proves an explicit strong deformation retract and exact core.

value.rationale: The result gives a uniform structural description for a canonical infinite family, not a one-off enumeration. It identifies the exact finite homotopy core of a natural configuration-space construction, shows that the two-particle space retains the minimal sphere core despite quadratic growth in points, and supplies a closed-form beat-collapse mechanism that can serve as a benchmark for higher-particle or nonminimal finite models.
